title: The Color Purple

vibeProfile.oneLine: A abused Black woman in the South slowly claims her life, through the love of women.

summary: Told in letters, first to God and then to a long-lost sister, this is the story of Celie, a poor Black woman in the early-twentieth-century South who survives abuse and degradation and, through the love of other women, slowly claims her own life and voice. Alice Walker's Pulitzer-winning novel is harrowing and, ultimately, radiant, a story of endurance, sisterhood and hard-won joy written in an unforgettable vernacular voice. One of the landmark American novels of its century.
whyReadIt: A harrowing, ultimately radiant novel of survival and sisterhood. It earns every bit of its final joy.

funFacts.text: It won the Pulitzer Prize and the National Book Award, and was later filmed and staged as a musical.
